details.short_description: Network packet compression and throttling configuration. Response to [`RequestNetworkSettings`](request-network-settings).
details.long_description: After receiving [`RequestNetworkSettings`](request-network-settings) from the client, the server should send this packet in response, and start following the declared settings (e.g. start compressing packets).

fields.name: compression_threshold
fields.description: Packets with size >= this threshold will be compressed according to [`compression_algorithm`](#$type-$root-$field-compression-algorithm). Setting this to `0` disables compression.

fields.name: compression_algorithm
fields.description: Algorithm used to compress applicable packets.

types.name: CompressionAlgorithm
types.description: A compression algorithm to apply to network packets.

members.name: None
members.description: Do not compress packets. This can also be achieved by setting [`compression_threshold`](#$type-$root-$field-compression-threshold) to `0`.
